summary: War Thunder entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: War Thunder

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC full client at high settings

primary.why: War Thunder is a cross-platform live MMO for Windows, Linux, Mac, PlayStation, and Xbox. Windows PC has the strongest graphics/settings, full-client, input, capture, and custom-content route, and no platform-exclusive campaign content exists elsewhere.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current full Windows client, set graphics for the capture target, and record the update/version because War Thunder is an evolving online service. Keep console routes for comparison only.

all_releases.fidelity: Highest settings/capture ceiling and full PC ecosystem route.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity and capture route for the live service.

all_releases.fidelity: Official PC-family clients with no sourced content advantage over Windows.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful system alternates; Windows remains the preferred capture/settings route.
skip: same live-service battlefield focus, lower settings/mod/capture flexibility than PC, and no sourced exclusive story route.
skip: same service family with no sourced exclusive content that would force a secondary archive run.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive campaign/content split is sourced; this is a live-service version-state question.

entries.remaster_caveats: War Thunder Mobile is a related separate mobile product. Archive notes should record the War Thunder update/version and event state.
